tools.name: query_logs
tools.description: Run a KQL query on a Log Analytics workspace over a time range, for example AppRequests | where Success == false | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Name. Returns each table's columns and rows, at most 500 rows, and a link to the workspace's logs.

limit.description: The most items to return, 1 to 500. Default 100.

query.description: The KQL query, passed to Log Analytics as given. Use take or summarize to keep the result small.

since.description: The start of the range, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z. Default: one hour before until.

until.description: The end of the range, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z. Default: now.

workspace.description: The workspace name or ID. It may be left out when Sidekick reads only one workspace.

tools.name: query_metrics
tools.description: Read Azure Monitor platform metrics of one resource over a time range, such as Requests or CpuPercentage, optionally split by a dimension filter. Returns each series' dimensions and points, oldest first.

aggregation.description: How points are aggregated. Default Average.

filter.description: An OData dimension filter, passed to Azure Monitor as given, for example "Instance eq '*'" to split by instance.

interval.description: The time grain of the points. Default: the smallest that gives at most 120 points.

limit.description: The most items to return, 1 to 50. Default 10.

namespace.description: The metric namespace, for example Microsoft.Web/sites. Default: the resource's own.

resource.description: The resource whose metrics to read. Its full resource ID, for example /subscriptions/<id>/resourceGroups/shop/providers/Microsoft.Web/sites/checkout.

since.description: The start of the range, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z. Default: one hour before until.

until.description: The end of the range, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z. Default: now.

tools.name: list_alerts
tools.description: List the Azure Monitor alerts of a subscription that started in a time range, newest first: severity, state, condition, rule, target resource, times and a portal link.

limit.description: The most items to return, 1 to 100. Default 30.

resource.description: Only alerts on this resource. Its full resource ID, for example /subscriptions/<id>/resourceGroups/shop/providers/Microsoft.Web/sites/checkout.

resourceGroup.description: Only alerts on resources in this resource group.

since.description: Only alerts that started at or after this time, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z. Default: 24 hours before until.

state.description: Only alerts whose condition is fired or resolved. Default any.

subscription.description: The subscription ID. It may be left out when Sidekick reads only one subscription.

until.description: Only alerts that started before this time, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z. Default: now.

tools.name: list_changes
tools.description: List what changed in a subscription in a time range, newest first, from its Activity Log: deployments, writes, deletes and actions on resources, with who made them and whether they failed.

limit.description: The most items to return, 1 to 500. Default 100.

resource.description: Only changes to this resource. Its full resource ID, for example /subscriptions/<id>/resourceGroups/shop/providers/Microsoft.Web/sites/checkout.

resourceGroup.description: Only changes in this resource group.

since.description: Only changes at or after this time, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z. Default: 24 hours before until.

subscription.description: The subscription ID. It may be left out when Sidekick reads only one subscription.

until.description: Only changes before this time, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z. Default: now.

tools.name: get_resource_health
tools.description: Get the Resource Health of one resource: available, degraded or unavailable, why, and since when. Without resource, list the resources of the subscription that are not available, and the Azure service health events that affect it.

resource.description: The resource to check. Leave it out to check the whole subscription. Its full resource ID, for example /subscriptions/<id>/resourceGroups/shop/providers/Microsoft.Web/sites/checkout.

since.description: Only service health events updated at or after this time, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z. Default: 24 hours before until.

subscription.description: The subscription ID. It may be left out when Sidekick reads only one subscription.

until.description: Only service health events updated before this time, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z. Default: now.

tools.name: get_aks_cluster
tools.description: Get an AKS cluster: provisioning and power state, Kubernetes version, upgrade channel, and its node pools with their state, version, size and autoscaling. Without cluster, list the subscription's clusters with their state.

cluster.description: The cluster's name. Leave it out to list the clusters.

resourceGroup.description: The cluster's resource group. Required with cluster.

subscription.description: The subscription ID. It may be left out when Sidekick reads only one subscription.
